title: Biggest Block of Rock
statement:
A map is a grid of cells: `#` is rock and `.` is empty. Two rock cells belong to the same block if you can walk from one to the other through rock cells, moving up, down, left or right. Find the number of cells in the largest block. If there is no rock, print `0`.

## Input
The first line contains `n` and `m`. Each of the next `n` lines is a string of `m` characters.

## Output
Print the size of the largest block.

## Constraints
- `1 <= n, m <= 300`
